title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were identified from the provided sources and ranked by the number of sources that mentioned them. The Hsu Research CCB‑8 was chosen as the best overall because it is the only product with detailed performance data and a clear advantage in sound quality.
assumptions: Prices are not included because the sources do not provide current pricing information.
